SECOND.description: Bi-temporal 2D semantic change detection on remote-sensing imagery. The task is to identify changed regions and reason about land-cover semantics at both times; binary change is supervised over the image, while semantic discrimination is used for changed regions.

LEVIR-CD.description: Bi-temporal 2D building change detection on remote-sensing imagery. The target semantic object is building, and changed regions correspond to building additions or removals. The dataset provides binary changed-versus-unchanged supervision only and does not provide per-time semantic labels.

LandsatSCD.description: Bi-temporal 2D semantic change detection on Landsat imagery. The task is to identify changed regions and reason about land-cover semantics at both times using the declared land-cover classes.

NYC-SCD.description: Bi-temporal 3D semantic change detection on urban point clouds. Predict per-point semantic classes at both times and directional change events; the event protocol is unchanged, added, and removed, with removed supported at Time 1 and added supported at Time 2. Vegetation participates in semantic classification but is excluded from change-event labeling.
